source: Summarised from the AP Common Zoning Regulations 2025, G.O. Ms. No. 216 dated 22.10.2025, Section V, which the Revised Master Plan 2041 legend names as the regulations the plan is read with. G.O. 216 was superseded by the Common Zoning Regulations 2026, notified as G.O. Ms. No. 157 dated 17.07.2026, nine days after this plan was sanctioned on 08.07.2026. These summaries have not been re-checked against G.O. 157, which is not reachable from outside India. The 2026 regulations are reported to work as a zone-wise negative list, activities permitted unless specifically prohibited, so a permit list here is not exhaustive and absence from a prohibit list is not a permission. Buffers along rivers, canals, drains, streams and tanks are governed by the AP Building Rules 2017. Read the current G.O. for the exhaustive text.

permit: All residential buildings, apartments, group housing, shop-cum-residences, townships
Hostels, boarding and guest houses, service apartments, staff quarters
Post offices, police and fire stations, government and local-body offices, electric sub-stations
Playgrounds, parks, libraries, gardens, gymnasia, yoga and health clinics
Tiffin centres, restaurants, bakeries, banks and ATMs
Play schools through junior colleges
prohibit: Blue, Green, Orange and Red category industries
Petrol, gas and diesel filling stations
Cinemas, multiplexes, malls, large commercial establishments
Hospitals over 20 beds; hospitals for contagious diseases
Warehousing, cold storage, wholesale mandis, junk yards, slaughter houses
Dairy, poultry, fish farms, hatcheries, piggeries
Truck and bus terminals, goods and logistics hubs

permit: Shops, retail, offices, business establishments
Hotels, restaurants, banquet halls
Cinemas, malls, entertainment
Banks, professional offices
Everything permitted in Residential, Commercial, Public & Semi-Public and Transportation
Industries except Red and Orange category
Subject to the road width in the building rules
Government and institutional buildings
Educational, health, religious and cultural facilities
Utilities and civic amenities
prohibit: Private residential and commercial development beyond the notified use

permit: Work Centre zone: Green and White category industries
Red and Orange category industries only in the belt zoned for them
Warehousing, logistics and allied uses
prohibit: Residential development within the industrial use
Category of industry other than the one the belt is zoned for

permit: Parks, playgrounds, gardens, sports facilities
Open space and green recreation
Roads, rail, metro, terminals and transport infrastructure
Associated utilities
All agriculture and horticulture
Farmhouse up to 5% plinth, G+1, on a plot of at least 0.5 acre
Food processing and agro-based industry with proper access
White, Green and Blue category industry with change-of-land-use charges
Solar and wind stations, cold storage, warehousing of local produce
prohibit: Heavy, noxious, hazardous and extractive industries
On notified forest land, only afforestation is permitted

permit: Heritage buildings, monuments, precincts and archaeological sites, under the Heritage Regulations
Defence and military land, per the defence manual

Protected water.headline: No construction is permitted in the water-spread. The boundary is the full tank level, and where records disagree the irrigation and revenue records are final.
permit: Fishing, boating and picnics along the banks
Open jetties, house boats, fishing platforms, rain shelters and snack bars, each under 100 sq m

Protected forest.headline: No development except agriculture, horticulture and forestry.
permit: Agriculture, horticulture, forestry
Parks, botanical gardens, picnic spots
Electrical sub-stations and communication towers, subject to Forest Department NOC
prohibit: Any built development beyond the above

Protected hills.headline: Development restricted zone. The plan's own 2021 regulations allowed IT, tourism and recreational projects on the hills outside eco-sensitive and heritage areas, so do not read this class as no-build.
permit: Afforestation and conservation uses
prohibit: Quarrying, mining and excavation of the hillside

Protected other.headline: Eco-sensitive, CRZ and green protected zone.
permit: Uses consistent with the Eco-Sensitive Zone and CRZ guidelines of MoEF&CC
